cipher.name: VowelConsonantInterchangeCipher
cipher.idea: A highly structured, intuitive substitution cipher that swaps vowels with vowels and consonants with consonants using a fixed, simple offset. Vowels (A, E, I, O, U) are shifted forward by 2 positions in the vowel sequence (A->I, E->O, I->U, O->A, U->E). Consonants are shifted forward by 3 positions in the consonant-only alphabet (B->F, C->G, D->H, F->J, etc., wrapping around). Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
1. Identify if the character is a letter. If not, leave it unchanged.
2. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U, case-insensitive), shift it forward by 2 positions in the vowel sequence: [A, E, I, O, U]. (A->I, E->O, I->U, O->A, U->E). Preserve the original case.
3. If it is a consonant, shift it forward by 3 positions in the consonant-only sequence: [B, C, D, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N, P, Q, R, S, T, V, W, X, Y, Z]. For example, B becomes F, C becomes G, Z wraps around to D. Preserve the original case.
cipher.decrypt_rules:
1. Identify if the character is a letter. If not, leave it unchanged.
2. If it is a vowel, shift it backward by 2 positions in the vowel sequence: [A, E, I, O, U]. (I->A, O->E, U->I, A->O, E->U). Preserve the original case.
3. If it is a consonant, shift it backward by 3 positions in the consonant-only sequence: [B, C, D, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N, P, Q, R, S, T, V, W, X, Y, Z]. For example, F becomes B, G becomes C, D wraps around to Z. Preserve the original case.
